amendments.because: Owner chose on 19 Nov 2026 to remove the run on main after each merge and gate merges on the nightly run instead
amendments.done_when: No main run starts when the merged commit's code equals what the pull request's CI tested (main did not move since), and Forge records that result for main; when several merges land close together, a newer main run cancels the running one and tests everything since the last green main result, and a red result names the merges it covered; merges still stop while main's newest result is red; new and existing repos get it on upgrade and forge sync

done_when: No test run starts on main after a merge; the nightly full run is the only run on main, and Forge merges nothing while main's newest nightly result is red, naming the nightly run and the repair step; new and existing repos get it on upgrade and forge sync
why: The run of related tests on main after each merge uses runners that waiting pull requests need, and it repeats the pull request's CI whenever main did not move between that CI and the merge
